verdict.rationale: Undermind documents parallel full-text extraction, answering specific questions across many papers at once, and custom tables. It also offers per-paper relevance judgment against a user's question, which approximates screening. However, it does not document a systematic screening workflow with explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria applied consistently, and a meta-analysis author reported it missed a sample-size exclusion. missing for 10: explicit user-defined inclusion/exclusion screening criteria, documented consistency/reproducibility of criteria across papers, screening audit trail (e.g., PRISMA-style), independent corroboration of extraction accuracy at scale.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can run a systematic screening and extraction workflow across many papers with consistent criteria

citations.quote: Reads full-text PDFs in parallel and answers specific questions across many papers at once, including from figures, tables, and equations.
Generate custom tables to support your research.
Quickly grasp if a paper is relevant to your unique question. Sort and filter however you like.
